unit: 215 public upstream YunoHost projects with pinned and deduplicated root manifests
primary: same frozen five-account additive name and version portfolios as first holdout
scope: Committed root-importer mandatory production paths. Follow verified npm workspace links from root. pnpm version 9 root paths are truncated at three edges. Separate workspace importers are diagnostics.
registry_identity: Exact canonical public npm tarball path or exact SHA-512 equality to fresh public registry metadata
negatives: Only npm paths evaluated completely under the supported root scope with all registry joins observed. A pnpm path can supply a positive witness. Other pnpm statuses and unsupported managers leave negatives unresolved.
estimands: Paired documented gross and net coverage change on the full frame, with conservative incomplete-evidence bounds. No cross-frame generalization or sampling-based equivalence claim.
time: Fixed consumer commits and a separate prospective registry observation queue. No historical publishing authority inferred.
